legend: You are an intern at a hyperscale AI data center that manages a linear array of n%%ZSMJ0%% GPUs. The i%%ZSMJ1%%-th GPU currently runs a compute load of ai%%ZSMJ2%%.

The data center hosts workloads for m%%ZSMJ3%% different companies. Each company j%%ZSMJ4%% uses a contiguous range of GPUs from index Lj%%ZSMJ5%% to Rj%%ZSMJ6%%. Different companies may share some GPUs if their computations are colocated for efficiency, so these ranges can overlap.

Before a major demonstration, the management team sets strict balance requirements. For each company j%%ZSMJ7%%, the total effective compute load across its range must lie between Aj%%ZSMJ8%% and Bj%%ZSMJ9%% inclusive.

You are allowed to adjust the load of each GPU by applying an integer change Δi%%ZSMJ10%%. Each adjustment can either increase or decrease the load, but all must stay within a non-negative common safety limit k%%ZSMJ11%%, meaning every GPU's load can change by at most k%%ZSMJ12%% units. The smaller the limit, the better the system stability, so you aim to meet all company requirements using the smallest possible k%%ZSMJ13%%.
Additionally, for hardware stability, each GPU must remain above the minimal safe operating load after adjustment: ai+Δi≥1%%ZSMJ14%% for all i%%ZSMJ15%%.
Find the minimum integer k%%ZSMJ16%% such that there exist integer adjustments Δ1,Δ2,…,Δn%%ZSMJ17%% satisfying, for every company j%%ZSMJ18%%,
If this is impossible for any k%%ZSMJ20%%, output -1.
input: The first line contains two integers n%%ZSMJ21%% and m%%ZSMJ22%% (1≤n,m≤1⋅103)%%ZSMJ23%% — the number of GPUs and the number of companies.
The second line contains n%%ZSMJ24%% integers a1,a2,…,an%%ZSMJ25%% (1≤ai≤109)%%ZSMJ26%% — the current compute loads of the GPUs.

Each of the following m%%ZSMJ27%% lines describes one company and contains four integers Lj%%ZSMJ28%%, Rj%%ZSMJ29%%, Aj%%ZSMJ30%%, and Bj%%ZSMJ31%% (1≤Lj≤Rj≤n,1≤Aj≤Bj≤1012)%%ZSMJ32%%, meaning the j%%ZSMJ33%%-th company uses all GPUs from index Lj%%ZSMJ34%% to Rj%%ZSMJ35%% and its total load must lie between Aj%%ZSMJ36%% and Bj%%ZSMJ37%% inclusive.
output: Print a single integer: the minimal possible k%%ZSMJ38%% such that there exist integer adjustments meeting all company conditions, the per-GPU safety floor ai+Δi≥1%%ZSMJ39%%, and |Δi|≤k%%ZSMJ40%% for all GPUs. If no such k%%ZSMJ41%% exists, print −1%%ZSMJ42%%.
note: For the sample test, k=0%%ZSMJ43%% or k=1%%ZSMJ44%% are not feasible. For k=2%%ZSMJ45%%, possible final compute load distributions include [4,7,4,6,3]%%ZSMJ46%% or [3,8,4,6,2]%%ZSMJ47%%.
